World of Warcraft Forums

# Removing Friendly Trivial NPC Names

Guides UI and Macro

[vstep-1031527](https://us.forums.blizzard.com/en/wow/u/vstep-1031527) (vstep) June 18, 2020, 7:00pm 1

I logged into my friends computer which had ElvUI installed. Now when i login to my character on my computer, Every NPC has a green bar above their head instead of just normal players. My other characters do not have this problem, only my main which I logged into on the other computer. Anyone have an idea of how to fix this so that it goes back to only showing nameplates/bars for friendly players and not friendly NPC’s

[Ketho-boulderfist](https://us.forums.blizzard.com/en/wow/u/Ketho-boulderfist) June 18, 2020, 8:10pm 2

Try this

```
/run SetCVar("nameplateShowFriendlyNPCs", 0)
```

otherwise you can reset all your cvars with

```
/console cvar_default
```

# CVar BlockTrades

From Warcraft Wiki

Jump to navigation Jump to search

Enables a user to block all trades from other users.

## Default Setting

0

## Possible Settings

0
    Off
1
    On

## Changing this setting

In-game, type the following
```
/console BlockTrades setting
```

Alternatively, you can exit wow, open the Config-cache.wtf file, and add the following line:

```
SET BlockTrades setting
```

# Console variables

* [History](https://wowpedia.fandom.com/wiki/Console_variables?action=history)
* [Purge](https://wowpedia.fandom.com/wiki/Console_variables?action=purge)
* Talk (15)

| |The API is no longer being updated here until further notice. |
| --- | --- |

    _For  Classic cvars, see Console variables/Classic ._

The _World of Warcraft_ game client stores all of its configurations in console variables ( **CVars** ). These variables affect many aspects of the game such as the graphics, the sound system and the interface.

The value of a CVar can be queried with GetCVar . The complete list of CVars is available from C\_Console.
GetAllCommands .

## Contents

* 1 Setting CVars
  
    + 1\.1 SetCVar
    + 1\.2 Console
    + 1\.3 Config.wtf
* 2 CVar Scope
* 3 Resetting CVars
* 4 List of Console Variables
* 5 List of Console Commands

There are several ways of setting the console variables. The most commonly used CVars are tied to the Interface window settings.

AddOns and scripts can set CVars by calling SetCVar .

```
/ run SetCVar ( "scriptErrors" , 1 )
```

[](https://static.wikia.nocookie.net/wowpedia/images/2/2b/Icon-information-22x22.png/revision/latest?cb=20070126022822 "Note")

**Note:** Secure CVars 🛡️ cannot be set in combat and only with `SetCVar` instead of with `/console` .

With the `/console` slash command.

```
/console scriptErrors 1
```

The `/console enable` command or launching the game with the `WoW.exe -console` argument will allow you to open the Console window in-game by pressing the ````` or `~` key.

The Config.
wtf file stores settings mostly relevant to game startup, such as `gxMaximize` for the screen window size and `locale` for the language.

```
World of Warcraft\_retail_\WTF\Config.wtf
```

The config-cache.wtf files are used for character and WoW account-specific settings. They are synchronized to the server if the synchronizeConfig CVar is enabled (by default).

```
World of Warcraft\_retail_\WTF\Account\ <AccountName> \ <Server> \ <Character> \config-cache.wtf
World of Warcraft\_retail_\WTF\Account\ <AccountName> \config-cache.wtf
```

Config files can be manually edited while the game is not running; they would otherwise be overwritten on reloading or logging out.

Some CVars are character-specific or WoW account-specific, for example:

* When setting nameplateMotion , it will only be changed for your current character.
* When setting chatBubbles , it will not be changed for any other WoW accounts on your Blizzard account.
Use GetCVarDefault or the cvar\_default command to reset a CVar, for example:

```
/ run SetCVar ( "autoSelfCast" , GetCVarDefault ( "autoSelfCast" ))
```

```
/console cvar_default autoSelfCast
```

The [AdvancedInterfaceOptions](https://www.curseforge.com/wow/addons/advancedinterfaceoptions) addon can show which cvars were changed from the default:

[](https://static.wikia.nocookie.net/wowpedia/images/1/14/AdvancedInterfaceOptions_cvar_browser.png/revision/latest?cb=20201204191002) 

AdvancedInterfaceOptions cvar browser

To reset the whole user interface:

```
/console cvar_default
```

    [](https://static.wikia.nocookie.net/wowpedia/images/e/e8/Icon-warning-22x22.png/revision/latest?cb=20101018021807 "Red exclamation mark icon") Changing a character or account-specific CVar cannot be undone or reverted by uninstalling, repairing the game or [deleting](https://us.battle.net/support/en/article/7549) the WTF folder as they will be synchronized from the server again.

--[[
	ConsoleGetAllCommands() returns a list of tables in this format:
		category: number from 0 to 9 representing a category above
		command: cvar name
		commandType: 0 seems to represent a cvar, 1 is a script command (like quit)
		help: cvar description text
--]]

-- Returns filtered list of CVars
function addon:GetCVars()
  local cvars = {}
  for _, info in ipairs(addon:GetAllCommands()) do
    if
      info.commandType == 0 -- cvar, rather than script
      and info.category ~= 0 -- ignore debug category
      and not strfind(info.command:lower(), "debug") -- a number of commands with "debug" in their name are inexplicably not in the "debug" category
      and info.category ~= 8 -- ignore GM category
      and addon:CVarExists(info.command) -- real cvar?
    then
      table.insert(cvars, info)
    end
  end
  return cvars
end
